#5 Things the ghoul needs now

![5 things the ghoul needs now](/uploads/481_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update 03/24/2025] Discord links to 4 & 5 updated

I hope you're all having fun being ghouls so far!

In this article I would like to suggest a few changes that might be helpful for ghouls that don't exist yet. Not only am I writing about it here, but I'm also suggesting all of this in the official Bethesda Discord so that these ideas actually make their way into Fallout 76. Feel free to vote for them if you like them.

## 1. Ghoul player icons

Support and agree with this idea: Discord Link

The most important thing the Ghoul needs is a unique symbol in the player name. Perks like "**Joined Forces**" require other ghouls on your team, and we currently don't know who is a ghoul and who is human. The solution is very simple. Basically the same as what we already see in the character menu. Simply add the radioactive symbol to the player name. At the end or between the title and name, it doesn't matter. Let's just see who a ghoul is. This is essential.

![Ghoul Playername Icons](/uploads/nukaknights-post-5thingstheghoulneeds-player-icons.jpg)

## 2. “The Fix” against gold

Support this idea and agree: Discord link

We need the “fix” for gold. Samuel and Mortimer can sell him for gold. “The Fix” is a Quality of Life item like the perfect chewing gum for humans and is currently only awarded once in the Ghoulification quest. We need more of it.

The Fix fills a large portion of the ferocity meter to make us ghouls less feral. Unless you're a wild melee ghoul, you'll need tons of chems. A little bit of “The Fix” every now and then will be helpful. And honestly, I think that's exactly what it was made for.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghouls-the-fix.jpg)

## 3. Ferocity Consumable

Support this idea and vote for it: Discord link

Thirdly, we also need something with the opposite effect of “The Fix”. Something to switch into ferocity mode quicker. Right now the only option is to wait… and wait… and wait. This isn't very practical and since we have control over our stats, radiation, glow etc, it should be possible to control the ferocity mode too.

This could be especially helpful if you only play one character with different loadouts. With a Wild Ghoul melee loadout you want ferocity, with a Ghoul commando or a heavy weapon build you don't want it. For example, switching to Wild Ghoul Melee for daily operations is currently not possible.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-feral-bar.png)

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-feral-ghoul-2h-melee-20250314130008-1.jpg)

## 4. Custom quick heal option

Support this idea and upvote: Discord link

The fourth idea is a custom quick heal. Currently, only stimpacks can be used in order from weak to strong. Hydraskillz (Bethesda developer) has already shown a mockup for a custom quick heal option that deploys stronger healing stim packs first.

![](/uploads/messenger-creation-93f9ad68-bc17-462d-928d-b0c847c63627.jpg) 

But why don't we go one step further? **Let's customize the item we want to use for healing.** This could be **poisonous slime** for ghouls. The goal is to fill the glow faster on consoles too. Because on consoles we don't have hotkeys and using the quick dial takes longer. Also, I think poisonous slime should also heal ghouls like stimpacks do under 100% health.
